sql:
select 'dep' k, d.deployment_key a, d.kind b, coalesce(d.ended_at::text,'OPEN') c from experiment_deployments d where d.deployment_key in ('mmsell-ceiling-live-1','mmsell-capacity-live-1','mmsell-contestcap-live-2','mmsell-sizesplit-live-2','mmsell-cellsize-live-1','mmsell-winset-live-1','mmsell-winset2-live-1','mmsell-cellsize2-live-1','mmsell-winset3-live-1')
union all
select 'ie', i.kind, coalesce(d.deployment_key,'-'), i.detected_at::text||' '||left(i.description,90) from experiment_integrity_events i left join experiment_deployments d on d.id=i.deployment_id where i.detected_at > '2026-11-01 22:55'
union all
select 'pt', strategy, count(*)::text, max(created_at)::text from paper_trades where created_at > '2026-11-01 23:02' group by strategy
